rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_HTTPS_Profile {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beaconing over HTTPS based on traffic pattern and string entropy"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        date = "2026-04-11"
        hash = "e86f10ba1f3d2c4e5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f"
    strings:
        $a = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT" wide ascii
        $b = "/index.php" wide ascii
        $c = "Accept: */*" wide ascii
        $d = { 00 00 00 00 ?? ?? ?? ?? 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 } // High entropy block
    condition:
        all of ($a, $b, $c) and $d
}
